name: Should I build a detached ADU or convert part of my existing home for multigenerational living?

mainEntity.name: Should I build a detached ADU or convert part of my existing home for multigenerational living?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between a detached ADU and an attached conversion depends on your property layout, budget, and desired level of privacy. A detached ADU typically offers more independence and privacy for occupants, and potentially greater rental value. A conversion, like transforming a garage, might be more cost-effective and quicker to complete, leveraging existing structures and utilities. Consider factors such as available space, noise transfer, and long-term family needs when making this decision.
acceptedAnswer.description: A detached ADU offers more privacy and independence, while an attached conversion can be more cost-effective, depending on budget and property layout.
